ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. For latency over a frozen workload distribution, the maximum assurance any H1-H8 system can provide is: (a) an EXACT, offline-verifiable deterministic cost certificate — for every workload item x, a cost value C(f,x) in abstract units (operations executed, bytes hashed, bytes consed, stage invocations) that any third party recomputes to bit-equality, so every quantile of the cost distribution over the frozen workload is a theorem, not a sample; plus (b) a fail-closed cost-budget gate blocking any run whose certified cost exceeds a committed budget; plus (c) a wall-clock claim whose CEILING is K-OF-N EXTERNAL-TIME-AUTHORITY BRACKETING (v1 corrected — producer attestation is NOT the maximum): an offline-verifiable wall-clock BRACKET on a run, obtained by binding committed run events to timestamps from k of n independent external time authorities — Roughtime-class malfeasance-provable timestamps, qualified (eIDAS-class) timestamp authorities, timestamped witness cosignatures — verified against pinned third-party keys with ZERO PRODUCER TRUST, the residue being trust in the external time quorum; the weaker form 'certified cost x attested machine rate r' (producer-signed rate) remains admissible as a typed lower rung. No system can make wall-clock seconds offline-verifiable with zero trust in ANY party; with zero PRODUCER trust, external-authority bracketing is the supremum.
derivation: (1) No-go, restated precisely: wall-clock duration is not a pure function of committed inputs — a replaying verifier obtains a different number — so wall-clock is never verifiable by recomputation alone. The v1 conclusion that producer attestation is therefore the ceiling was too weak: interval BRACKETING by independent external time authorities yields offline-verifiable upper (and lower) bounds on a run's wall-clock extent against pinned third-party keys — zero producer trust, with trust relocated to an external quorum whose malfeasance is provable (Roughtime-class) or legally accountable (qualified timestamps). Hence the wall-clock ceiling is k-of-n external-time-authority bracketing; producer-signed machine rate is a strictly weaker rung. (2) Exactness of the fully-zero-third-party-trust part: because H5 makes the derivation deterministic, the multiset {C(f,x)} over the frozen workload is a computable function of the committed workload — mean, p50, p99, max are exactly computable and re-derivable; sampling error is eliminated entirely. (3) H3 permits the strongest enforcement compatible with the no-go: a fail-closed blocking budget gate on certified cost. The abstract-cost certificate remains the only component requiring zero trust in ANY third party; the bracketing clause is resource-parameterized by the declared time-authority set.
relativity_note: The wall-clock bracketing clause is parameterized by the declared external time-authority set (k, n, key pins); the cost-certificate clause is invariant.
lean_obligation: Theorem (cost determinism and exact quantiles): given f pure, there is a unique c : Input -> Nat with cost e = c x for every execution e of f on x; for a frozen workload w, quantile q (w.map c) is a computable function of w alone, equal across independent replays. No-go lemma: no function of committed inputs equals wall-clock unless wall-clock is constant across conforming executions. Bracketing theorem: given k-of-n timestamp evidence sets over committed run events with pinned authority keys, under an honest-majority assumption on the authority quorum, the verified bracket [lo, hi] contains the true run interval — the quorum assumption appears as an explicit hypothesis, making the relocated trust syntactically visible. Budget gate soundness: c x > budget implies the run is blocked (fail-closed, H3).

ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. Resource-normalized throughput of any H1-H8 system on p workers is bounded by T_p >= max(W/p, S, ceil(n/b) * c_batch): W = total verification/generation work, S = span of the input dependency DAG, and ceil(n/b) * c_batch = the BATCHED AMORTIZED serialization floor for appending n accountable transitions through the single logical serialization point (H4/H6) in batches of b — batched Merkle appends amortize to O(1) hashing per item with O(log n) proof material per append, so the floor is per-BATCH serialization, not per-transition ('irreducibly serial per transition' is retracted). Verification work W has an operative floor under the declared toolchain: a zero-producer-trust verifier in recompute mode must read and hash every committed byte at least once, so throughput is capped by min(I/O bandwidth, hash bandwidth) per admitted byte; on unchanged inputs, content-addressed memoization reduces work to the delta plus one digest comparison per cached unit. Sublinear verification via succinct TRANSPARENT proof systems (no trusted setup; hash-family assumptions) is not cryptographically excluded — its absence here is a declared-toolchain/arithmetization cost fact, which is exactly what the RESOURCE_BOUNDED kind records. The ceiling is attained by deterministic parallel-map with ordered serial fold; all bounds derived from committed corpus configuration, never constants.
derivation: (1) Serialization floor, corrected: H4 plus H6 force a total order on admissions — one logical serialization point (physical single writer, or machine-checked nonforking replicated order); commit throughput is bounded by that point's sequential rate, and the optimum is batched commitment: group b transitions per batch, one serialized append per batch, per-item cost one hash amortized, O(log n) proof material — hence the floor ceil(n/b) * c_batch, which the attainment schedule itself uses. (2) Work/span law (Brent): any p-worker schedule has makespan >= max(W/p, S) — implementation-independent. (3) Verification floor, restated honestly: under zero producer trust in RECOMPUTE mode, trusting k bytes requires reading k bytes (Omega(k) I/O and hashing). The v1 exclusion of succinct proofs by 'trusted setup' was false — STARK-class systems are transparent; the honest exclusion ground is toolchain/arithmetization cost only, so the linear floor is OPERATIVE (toolchain-relative), not absolute — consistent with the AX-06/AX-13 v2 split. (4) Determinism costs nothing asymptotically: parallel-map with deterministic ordered reduction achieves the same T_p bound with byte-identical output — any design paying throughput for determinism is below ceiling.
relativity_note: The linear verification floor and the batch constant c_batch are relative to the declared toolchain and storage/hash bandwidth; the work/span law and the existence of a serialization floor are model-independent.
lean_obligation: Theorem (schedule optimality with batched accountable commit): for a dependency DAG with work W and span S, and a total-ordered commit relation with per-batch cost c_batch and batch size b, every conforming p-worker schedule satisfies T_p >= max (W/p) (max S (ceil(n/b) * c_batch)), and the ordered-parallel-map/serial-fold schedule achieves T_p <= W/p + S + ceil(n/b) * c_batch with output extensionally equal to the sequential schedule. Amortization lemma: total hashing over n batched appends is O(n) with O(log n) proof material per append. Verification floor lemma (recompute mode): a sound zero-producer-trust recomputing verifier over committed bytes b reads at least |b| positions (indistinguishability of strings differing at an unread index). Incremental floor: unchanged cached unit re-verifies in exactly one digest comparison.

ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum inspectable causal account any H1-H8 system can give for a trusted decision is the decision's own replayable derivation: a trace, recomputable to bit-equality by third parties from committed inputs (H5/H8), in which every trusted effect appears exactly once with its cause chain back to committed inputs. Completeness of the account equals completeness of effect mediation (H4 capability closure), and — THE RELATIVITY STATED HERE, IN THE STATEMENT — it is attainable at TWO RUNGS: (RUNG 1, structural, available without verified-compilation resources) a construction-level local invariant of the single mediation seat making effect-execution and trace-emission the same event inside the same all-or-nothing transition (H6), so an untraced trusted act is structurally impossible relative to the declared effect semantics, with absence of out-of-model effects enforced by the OS capability model, not proven of arbitrary code; (RUNG 2, strictly stronger, gated on AX-21 verified-compilation/verification resources) machine-checked whole-perimeter verification of the mediator and runtime, proving of the code itself that no effect path bypasses the mediation seat — Rice bars DECIDING arbitrary code, not VERIFYING constrained code that carries proofs. Two hard limits bound both rungs from above: (a) no explanation can carry more causal information than the derivation itself — every sound account is a function of the replay trace; (b) a causal account of WHY an untrusted candidate was proposed (statistical-producer internals, H1) is out of trusted scope — the admission/refusal derivation is the entire trusted causal story.
derivation: (1) Information-theoretic supremum: under H5 a trusted decision is a pure finite computation from committed inputs; the full derivation determines the decision and every true causal statement about it; any account not derivable from the trace asserts causation the computation does not contain (barred by H2). The ceiling is reached when the account IS the derivation, verified by recompute (H8). (2) Structural completeness, honestly two-runged (v1 corrected — the v1 text presented the local-invariant form as the maximum simpliciter while its own parenthetical conceded the stronger route): global no-bypass is undecidable for ARBITRARY code (Rice), but that does not cap proof-carrying constrained code — whole-perimeter verification is a feasible mechanism class gated on declared verification resources, so rung 1 is the maximum only relative to declining those resources, and the ceiling names both rungs. (3) H1 boundary: statistical-producer internals admit no faithful causal account with today's tools, and H1 makes this irrelevant — the candidate is data; the admission derivation over it is the complete trusted causal account. (4) Determinism of the account: the trace is a pure function of committed inputs, so independent verifiers derive identical accounts — explanation itself is replayable.
ceiling_kind: MODEL_RELATIVE (rung 1 relative to the declared capability-effect semantics; rung 2 additionally RESOURCE_BOUNDED on AX-21 verification resources)
relativity_note: Relative to a declared capability-effect semantics: an effect is an invocation through the capability mediation seat, and complete causal account means every such invocation appears in the trace with its cause chain. At rung 1, effects outside the declared model are excluded by the OS capability closure, enforced not proven; at rung 2 the exclusion is proven of the verified perimeter itself.

ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum any feasible H1-H8 system can achieve in self-falsification is a TWO-REGIME certified adequacy (v1 raised): (1) PROOF-CARRYING EXCLUSION OF INFINITE DEFECT CLASSES wherever a machine-checked functional-correctness or refinement proof covers a seat — the proof refutes the entire (infinite) class of semantics-altering defects relative to the committed spec on the verified perimeter, strictly exceeding any finite mutation class there; proof-carrying admission is a TOTAL DECIDABLE procedure over (code, proof) pairs — Rice bars DECIDING arbitrary semantic properties, it does not bar CHECKING a supplied proof; (2) for the unverified remainder, adversarial adequacy certified as 100 percent mutation-kill over a DECLARED, hash-committed, finite class M of mutation operators and counter-design generators, with the kill matrix an offline-recomputable release artifact (H8) — the FLOOR mechanism for the unproven region, not the global maximum; (3) every hypothesis, mutant, or counter-design outside both regimes — including any surviving mutant — is a typed UNKNOWN that fail-closed blocks release (H2/H3) and escalates to the accountable human authority as a certificate-carrying transition (H6). No system can certify refutation-completeness over the open class of all possible defects OUTSIDE its committed specs and committed finite classes — completeness claims are always relative to the committed spec/class registry.
derivation: Computability, applied honestly: Rice's theorem makes non-trivial semantic properties of arbitrary code undecidable — no total procedure DECIDES 'no superior counter-design exists' or 'no undetected defect exists'. But proof-CHECKING is decidable: a candidate arriving with a machine-checked proof is admitted by a total decidable check, and the proof refutes an infinite defect class relative to its spec — so the v1 ceiling (finite-class kill as the maximum) was strictly below the attainable maximum on any verified perimeter. Verification theory (Popper asymmetry): universal correctness claims are refutable, never verifiable — EXCEPT relative to a committed formal spec, where a correctness proof is exactly a refutation-completeness certificate for the spec'd class; outside specs, the strongest coherent artifact is a corroboration certificate relative to a committed enumerable falsifier class (hashed, else the certificate is itself unfalsifiable). Consistency: self-graded falsifiers without an externally recomputable kill matrix trust a declared root (H8 violation); continuing past a surviving mutant is silent degradation (H3 violation). The v1 closing phrase 'nothing feasible today exceeds it' is deleted — resource phrasing may not appear inside an ABSOLUTE label; the ceiling is stated as the two-regime structure itself.
ceiling_kind: ABSOLUTE (with the two-regime structure; completeness always relative to committed specs and committed classes)

Sigma is refuted by P (infinite-class exclusion: forall m, apply m V not-equiv-Sigma V implies not Correct(apply m V, Sigma)) and checkProof is a total decidable function of (code, proof); (R2 kill-regime) Admit S K implies forall m in M, exists f in F with runs f (apply m S) = FAIL, and recompute K (M, F, S) = K; (R3 fail-closed) a surviving mutant in M, or any candidate outside both regimes, implies not Admit and verdict = UNKNOWN_escalated — no third outcome exists in the verdict type.

ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum feasible evolvability guarantee is ratchet-monotonicity over the UNION of committed executable measures AND machine-checked preservation proofs (v1 raised): every admitted evolution step S_n to S_(n+1) carries a certificate that (1) recomputes (never trusts) the committed capability-floor vector Floors(S_n) from the previous release's hash-chained census, (2) proves pointwise measure(S_(n+1), c) >= measure(S_n, c) for every committed executable floor c, AND re-checks a machine-checked preservation/refinement proof for every committed spec'd behavior class B — a proof that S_(n+1) refines or preserves the invariants of B certifies non-regression over the INFINITE behavior class B, not merely its sampled measures, while the admission gate stays decidable because the candidate arrives WITH the proof; (3) proves the union (Floors union ProvenClasses)(S_n) is a subset of (Floors union ProvenClasses)(S_(n+1)) — the certified set itself only grows; (4) fail-closed refuses any step whose floor preservation or proof re-check cannot be established (H3/H7). Monotonicity is unattainable ONLY for capabilities NEITHER measured NOR covered by a preservation proof — that narrowed clause is the honest impossibility.
derivation: Computability, corrected: 'S_(n+1) at least as capable as S_n over ALL semantic capabilities' is undecidable (Rice) as a question about arbitrary candidates — but the v1 inference that a decidable gate therefore exists ONLY for executable measures conflated deciding with proof-checking: a machine-checked refinement/invariant-preservation proof for the step certifies non-regression over an infinite spec'd behavior class, and checking the supplied proof is decidable. Hence the ceiling is the union: executable committed measures PLUS preservation proofs over committed spec'd classes, monotone as a set. Storage/consistency: the floor-and-proof vector must be bound into an append-only hash chain (a floor drop must be a detectable chain break, not an overwritable claim) — else a producer lowers a floor and re-declares it, violating H8. Trade-off limit: unrestricted evolution and guaranteed invariant preservation are jointly unsatisfiable; under H3 the gate sacrifices evolution-liveness, never invariant-safety — every step not provably preserving (by measure or by proof) is blocked.
ceiling_kind: ABSOLUTE (with the widened measures-plus-proofs formula; the impossibility clause narrowed to capabilities neither measured nor proof-covered)

Prove: (ratchet) Admit (R n) (R (n+1)) implies Floors and Classes both grow monotonically, mu is pointwise non-decreasing on committed floors, and for every B in Classes (R n), checkProof (R (n+1)) B (pf (R (n+1)) B) = true — preservation over the infinite class B; (decidability) the whole admission predicate is decidable given the candidate's supplied proofs; (fail-closed) non-establishable preservation implies not Admit; (chain-monotone) floors and proven classes never decay across any distance; (tamper-evidence) a lowered floor with valid links contradicts collision resistance of H.

ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. For a declared toolchain commitment T, the maximum feasible architecture-to-source-to-executable assurance is a refinement chain in which every link is either (a) a machine-checked proof replayable offline by a small proof-checker kernel, or (b) recompute-and-compare conformance between independently produced artifacts (translation validation / diverse re-verification), terminating in an explicitly enumerated, minimized, hash-committed Trusted Computing Base (proof checker, compiler+runtime image, OS loader, hardware). No system transports a property to the executable with a smaller trust residue than this TCB, and no property is transported beyond what the weakest link carries. SUPERIOR TRANSPORT NAMED (supreme-law rule 3 declaration): a strictly smaller trust residue is reachable TODAY by retargeting the trusted kernel to a verified-compilation substrate — CakeML (verified, bootstrapped, offline-obtainable) or the Brack verified Scheme compiler built on it — which removes the diverse-double-execution mitigation from the compiler link entirely; for a deployment whose declared toolchain is an unverified compiler (e.g. a Common Lisp commitment, for which no verified compiler exists), link-type (b) is the optimum FOR THAT COMMITMENT, and the exclusion of the verified substrate is a declared scope choice of the creator, not a limit.
derivation: Verification theory: every proof chain bottoms out in an unverified checker plus hardware — the TCB is irreducible, only minimizable (a self-verifying checker is circular; Goedel II blocks self-certified consistency). Thompson's trusting-trust result: compiler trust cannot be discharged by source inspection alone; the mitigations are a verified compiler, diverse double-compilation, or independent re-execution of artifact-level claims. For a toolchain WITH a verified compiler substrate available (CakeML/Brack-class, which exists and is obtainable offline today), the compiler link becomes link-type (a) and the TCB strictly shrinks; for a declared toolchain WITHOUT one, link-type (b) is the optimum for the compiler link. Information-theoretic: a property claim about the executable carries at most the information transported through the chain; any claim exceeding the conjunction of link guarantees is unverifiable assertion (H8). Therefore ceiling = machine-checked links where a checker exists + recompute-and-compare links elsewhere + committed enumerated TCB — RESOURCE_BOUNDED because the verified substrate strictly shrinks the TCB and its exclusion is only a declared commitment.
relativity_note: Relative to the declared toolchain commitment. The frozen statement names the superior transport (CakeML/Brack verified-compilation substrate) as required by the supreme law when scope delivers less than the maximum; adopting it is a creator decision recorded outside this instrument.
lean_obligation: Define artifacts A (architecture spec), S (source model), E (executable image), a finite committed TCB, transported properties P over traces, refinement as trace inclusion. Prove per-link and compose: Refines S A and Conforms E S imply, assuming TCB, every transported property holds of E — where Refines is machine-checked and Conforms is the recompute predicate (load-time audit and independent re-verification returned equal digests), carried as an axiom-tagged hypothesis inside the TCB assumptions so the trust residue is syntactically visible: no conclusion about E exists outside the Assuming TCB context. Substrate-comparison lemma: under a verified-compiler hypothesis for the kernel's compilation, the Conforms axiom for that link is discharged and the TCB term strictly shrinks — the superiority of the named transport as a theorem schema, not prose.

ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum feasible cross-legal-order generality is profile-parametricity: every trusted mechanism (admission, provenance, replay, certificates, structural validation, citation grammar, deontic classification) is a single function parameterized by a hash-committed legal-order PROFILE supplied as data (article ranges, gazette/publisher identity and key material, language/script normalization, calendar, citation grammar, deontic lexicon), with a noninterference guarantee that no trusted decision depends on any jurisdiction fact except through the profile parameter; any legal order lacking a committed well-formed profile yields typed UNKNOWN (H2), never a guess. No feasible system can exceed this: mechanism-level universality is attainable, semantic-level universality is not — there exists no jurisdiction-free formal semantics of law, so content decisions are necessarily relative to the profile's committed model.
derivation: Information-theoretic: a validator's output can carry no information about a jurisdiction's structure that was not supplied as input; if the information is not in the committed profile, a decision about it is fabrication, structurally forbidden by H2. Full generality = moving ALL jurisdiction information out of code into committed data; the ceiling on the code side is exactly parametricity/noninterference (two runs differing only in un-profiled jurisdiction facts produce identical outputs or both UNKNOWN). Model-dependence is irreducible: deontic and structural semantics differ across legal orders, so correctness for order J is only definable relative to a formal model of J — the profile schema IS that model, and an order inexpressible in the schema is honestly out of scope (UNKNOWN), the H2-optimal outcome. Verification: the profile must be hash-committed into the release chain, else a producer swaps jurisdiction rules undetected (H8).
relativity_note: Relative to the committed legal-order profile SCHEMA — a chosen formal structural model of a legal order (work/expression/manifestation identity + gazette-anchored publication events + per-profile citation and deontic grammars). Generality claims hold for exactly the class of legal orders expressible in the schema; anything outside it is typed UNKNOWN by construction. Cross-order composition (conflict-of-laws meta-rules over profiles) is a distinct mechanism family adjudicated in the closure's taxonomy (DIM-15 family addition), not a ceiling change here: choice-of-law rules are themselves codifiable as committed meta-rulebases over profiles, with UNKNOWN for uncodified renvoi — inside this ceiling's parametricity form. Witness instantiation: appendix.
lean_obligation: Model trusted decision procedures as D : Profile -> Input -> Outcome with Outcome := PASS | FAIL | UNKNOWN, well-formedness WF : Profile -> Prop, jurisdiction facts partitioned into profiled and unprofiled parts.
